94: During the additional prayer of Shabbat - which is a new Priestly Benediction, since [the additional prayer] is not [recited] on the weekday, it is necessary to add something new to what the public says.

Blessed be the Lord out of Zion - this is not in the same psalm, which is why [the gemara] goes on to ask, "And let them also say "The Lord shall bless you out of Zion", as it is written in that same matter."
